name: Tumelo Muhau
bio: Leads the Group's technology and digitalization strategy, ICT procurement and project delivery, with extensive experience managing enterprise-scale ICT deployments for government, healthcare, education and private-sector clients across Zambia.
messageTitle: Smart, secure and future-ready ICT solutions for Zambia.
message: Technology is the foundation of innovation, operational excellence and sustainable business growth. Donmac has built a solid track record in ICT projects spanning procurement, installation, configuration and end-to-end support, serving some of Zambia's most prominent public institutions and development organisations.
Our network of partnerships with world-class ICT manufacturers ensures clients receive genuine, warranted and current technology that meets the highest standards of performance and durability.
